children: Insulet entered into a Ninth Amendment to its Credit Agreement to refinance $475 million of term loans and increase revolving commitments to $750 million. The new term loans carry margins of 0.75% for base rate and 1.75% for term SOFR, a 25 bps reduction from prior levels, with a 0.00% SOFR floor. Revolving loan margins were reduced to a 1.25%–1.75% SOFR-based range, tied to leverage. Proceeds refinanced the existing term loans, and the expanded revolver will support working capital and general corporate purposes.
: Amendment to Credit Agreement, including $475 million term loan refinancing and $750 million revolving credit facility
: Morgan Stanley Senior Funding, as administrative agent, and other lenders
: Lower borrowing costs and expand liquidity
